notes.title: Color Guardians Update 3 and Free Demo!
notes.notes:
Hello Guardians!

We are happy to share with you some GREAT news:

Color Guardians Update 3

 Maintainence update on boss levels and several other levels throughout the game!
 Several bugs fixes
 Steam badges and goodies are now working correctly!
 Fixed a rare crash for some users in the extras screen
 Small performance fix for some systems


Color Guardians Demo
We now have a free playable demo! Play as Rod and experience the crazyness of Color Guardians in a small dose! It features 5 different and amazing levels from our adventure, including Windmill breezes, Crystal Caves, and the Dark Fort.Tell all your friends about it! 

 http://store.steampowered.com/app/377770

We also wanted to let you know that a BIG update is coming really soon! Stay tuned!

- The Color Guardians Team

notes.title: Color Guardians Update 2 - Timing, bugs and Boss battle!
notes.notes:
Hello Guardians!

We are very happy to share with you the second Color Guardians update, addressing several of your concerns:

Faster timing on both unlocking a level and restarting after dying!
Fixed a credits freeze.
Several small bug fixes and glitches.
Removed a pesky column blocking visibility in the fort environment.
A weird bug sometimes happened allowing the player to get stuck in wall.
Screensaver will no longer show if player is using a gamepad.

Also, we are also excited to share with you an update with the Final Boss! We have watched you play and seen all your feedback, and the final boss has been tweaked so it feels more strategy-oriented over randomized feel, adding a much more rewarding experience!

Please let us know any other comments or feedback that you have for the game. Have a great weekend and keep on coloring!

- The Color Guardians team

notes.title: Color Guardians Update 1
notes.notes:
Hello Guardians! 

We have seen you play and listened to your feedback! We have made some changes, improvements and bug fixes.

New video settings window! Video settings have been updated with a much more intuitive navigation.
Fixed a game freeze when user pressed ESC button repeatedly on Main Menu
All UI buttons on score card are clickable.
Fixed some controller issues, including control scheme not being saved.
Water on mountains now have a nice animation.
Fixed a weird game reset when going back from options menu.
Some minor bugs and fixes.

We will be releasing another update with some more fixes, and a bit more tweaking so stay tuned! In the meantime, ´please let us know any other comments or feedback that you have for the game.

- The Color Guardians team
